explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says a transmission permutation τ is an involution (τ b = a ↔ τ a = b) when there is a marked-point swap automorphism under which the divisor D is linearly equivalent to its transmission dual. Every notion in that statement belongs to the library itself: TwiceMarked graphs, CFDiv divisors, linearEquiv, IsTransmissionPermutation, transmissionDualDivisor and MarkedPointSwap. Mathlib has no theory of chip-firing or Brill–Noether divisors on graphs. The proof only passes the hypotheses to another library lemma, Bananas.sectionFive_tau_involutive_of_dual_automorphism, after a translation step. The mathematical content therefore lies in the library's own definitions, and no Mathlib declaration carries it. I did not run a source search; this verdict rests on that reasoning alone.
